description: This Java source file defines the main entry point for the Snowman web application. It sets up and starts an embedded Jetty server, configures a web application context, and handles graceful shutdown. It is used for launching the server that serves the web application packaged in a shaded JAR.

classes.name: EnterpriseApplication
classes.description: Main class that initializes and runs an embedded Jetty server to serve the web application.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point method that sets up Jetty server, web app context, and manages application lifecycle.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Fetches resource URL as string using class loader; throws RuntimeException if resource not found.

methods.name: getResourceFilePath
methods.description: Gets filesystem path for a resource via URL, suitable for Jetty resource configuration; throws if resource not found.

methods.name: resolvePort
methods.description: Resolves server port from system property 'port', defaults to 3001 if not specified or invalid.
